note: unmutated worktree, engine oracle

the excluded node writes its entry. What it computed is the value of a position with one of its moves removed and the key is the position with the move in it, so every later probe of that position -- including the one the verification's own parent is about to make -- reads a score that is wrong by construction and an ordering move that is not the best one

the walk takes the table's move from any entry before a certified child, so a defender's reply out of an upper bound -- mated two plies early -- is walked and the line is refused short, where an exact child at the owed distance would have completed it
an aborted line the walk cannot complete against the last completed score is printed short beside it, although the last completed line starts with the same move and reaches the mate

an aborted line the walk leaves at or past the claimed distance is taken as reaching the mate, so one that runs to a longer mate is printed beside the shorter completed score with ponder from it, although the completed line starts with the same move and reaches the mate

an aborted line at or past the claimed distance and not checkmate there, with no completed line to give way to -- another first move, or a completed line that does not reach its own mate -- is printed as it is beside the completed mate score instead of being cut below the distance
the last completed line stands in for a short or wrong aborted line on its first move alone, so a completed line that does not reach its own mate replaces one that the cut would have left short

a line at or past its mate's distance that is not checkmate there is left as it is, so search() prints a completed iteration's line beside its own mate score that does not deliver it, and the aborted path's wrong line with no completed line to give way to is no longer cut

the cut drops its clamp, so beside `mate 1` a refused one-move line is cut to no moves: a printed line without the move played, and a finished iteration whose line comes back empty, which the loop reads as no result

the pass is made at a node a whole search found mated: a reduced search finds the defender's node mated by every move, the re-search at full depth passes, the pass fails high and the mating move is refuted
a mated bound from a node where a shallow-depth rule skipped a move also stops the pass -- the best of the moves searched read as the best move, S289's guard as it read H0
negamax's store says every move was searched whatever a rule skipped, which hands the guard the pruned bounds S289's read
negamax's store never says a node searched every move, so the guard never fires and the six mates in two are hidden again
the skip the engine's own node takes before make_move no longer marks the entry, so a pruned bound reads as a whole search's in play
the probed node's skip, after make_move, no longer marks the entry
a lower bound inside the mated band also stops the pass, though it says only that the node is worth at least a mate against it
any whole search's upper bound or exact score stops the pass, inside the band or not: a shallower estimate decides where the guard trusts a proof
an exact score inside the mated band no longer stops the pass: only the upper bound does, though the exact score is the same finding
reverse futility fires at a node a whole search found mated: the margin argues the opponent cannot win the difference back where a search of every move found the side to move mated by each of them
a mated bound from a node where a shallow-depth rule skipped a move also stops reverse futility -- the best of the moves searched read as the best move
a lower bound inside the mated band also stops reverse futility, though it says only that the node is worth at least a mate against it
any whole search's upper bound or exact score stops reverse futility, inside the band or not: a shallower estimate decides where the guard trusts a proof
an exact score inside the mated band no longer stops reverse futility: only the upper bound does, though the exact score is the same finding

a node that skipped a move and found every searched move mated returns and stores its fail-soft mated best, a mate distance no search established (the engine before S296: S145 mined line 168 reads mate 4 at depth 8 where the position is mate in 5)
a node that searched every legal move and found each mated also returns alpha: a proof of the mate replaced by the window's edge
